cases.name: Cassidy Chalee Madison Jackson
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "At the tender age of 23, Cassidy was a vibrant spirit filled with joy and love for those around her. Having graduated from Upperman High School in 2019, she embarked on a career at the Holiday Inn in Cookeville, where her cheerful nature surely brought smiles to guests and colleagues alike.

Cassidy was known for her happy demeanor and her deep affection for her family and friends. She cherished her role as a loving dog owner to her beloved companion, Toby, whom she had cared for since she was just seven years old. Her warmth and enthusiasm for life left an indelible mark on everyone who had the privilege to know her."
cases.narrative: On 4/11/2025, Cassidy was found on the road of Rachels Lane with a fatal gunshot wound to her head after she was reported missing by her family in Putnam County. Her Go Fund Me said: "Cassidy was abducted, robbed, and murdered."
